evals.prompt: Design a reproducible point-in-time commodity dataset from revised fundamentals, weather forecasts, and futures contracts for daily forecasting.
evals.expected_outcome: Produces an explicit use/data contract, separates observation/availability/ingestion/decision times, preserves vintages and contract-roll semantics, classifies missingness, and defines immutable dataset identity without taking model authority.

assertions.text: Defines a data contract covering grain, keys/cardinality, schema/semantics, units, temporal fields, nullability or missingness meaning, freshness/revision expectations, and consumers/use.
Separates observation, publication/availability, ingestion, revision/vintage, and decision-cutoff semantics and rejects future-known substitutions.
Preserves meaningful missingness causes, including not yet published versus source unavailable, rather than silently filling them.
Does not fit/tune/evaluate a model or claim trading, deployment, Git publication, external mutation, or lifecycle authority.

human_review: Result is specific enough to implement or audit without inventing source or time semantics.

evals.prompt: Audit this customer-event dataset before modeling. Joins are multiplying rows, some keys are null, and the source schema changed last month.
evals.expected_outcome: Diagnoses grain/key/cardinality and schema-contract failures before statistical complexity and gives a bounded fitness disposition.

assertions.text: States expected join cardinality and verifies duplicate keys, row-count change, unmatched keys, many-to-many expansion, and post-join missingness.
Treats key/type/unit/semantic changes as data contract evolution and does not equate storage-level schema merge with semantic compatibility.
Ends with fit, fit-with-caveats, or not-fit for the stated use and links material findings to evidence and impact.

human_review: The audit would catch silent row multiplication and semantic schema drift before model work starts.

evals.prompt: Specify an incremental streaming pipeline that can replay late and corrected events without duplicating outputs, and keep operating cost bounded.
evals.expected_outcome: Defines realistic idempotency/atomicity, CDC/replay, late-data/finality, schema-change, observability, and cost guarantees without claiming unsupported exactly-once behavior.

assertions.text: Defines idempotency, partial-write/atomic publication behavior, retry boundaries, replay/backfill semantics, and the actual delivery guarantee instead of casually claiming exactly-once.
Defines event time, allowed lateness or finality policy, correction handling, and how downstream consumers distinguish provisional from corrected results.
Considers incremental/CDC and resource trade-offs without weakening replayability, validation, or point-in-time correctness.

human_review: Pipeline guarantees are precise, testable, and technology-neutral.

evals.prompt: Freeze this feature dataset for repeated experiments and prove another researcher can reconstruct the same dataset later.
evals.expected_outcome: Defines a dataset manifest, logical content identity, deterministic canonicalization scope, reconstruction protocol, and clean handoff to model-tuning.

assertions.text: Defines deterministic logical content identity with explicit canonicalization scope and distinguishes it from byte identity when serialization is not deterministic.
Requires an independent reconstruction to recompute and match the declared logical dataset identity or explain the mismatch before equivalence is claimed.
Freezes source, data contract, dataset, feature, split, and preprocessing identities and hands predictive comparison or feature-value testing to model-tuning.

human_review: Reproducibility is demonstrated through identities and reconstruction, not asserted because a pipeline completed once.
